implementation.name: original-v2-hierarchical-allreduce
implementation.scope: Original two-node/two-GPU hierarchy; provenance identifies contributors, no timing or byte model.
implementation.question: How do local partial sums become a full result on every GPU?

purpose: Expose partial-sum ownership, cross-node reduction, and final local copying on the original three panels.
storyboard: Local ReduceScatter assigns node A/B sums to different GPUs
Node 0 sends partials; node 1 combines each with its own
Completed global shards return without addition
Local AllGather copies global finished sums
guard: Three panels repeat the same GPUs, not twelve different ranks. Reduce uses disjoint provenance; AllGather copies full sums only. No measured speedup. Inter-node AllReduce illustrates a reduction-and-return, not a claimed library algorithm.
